summary.intent: Complete the CipherBox v2 wayfinder map's final ticket (deployment/infra/release blueprint), then execute the v1 freeze and repo handover to kick off v2 implementation, adopting an AGENTS.md-as-source-of-truth pattern and cleaning up v1/GSD cruft along the way.
summary.outcome: Merged blueprint/deploy.md (PR 55), closed the wayfinder map and ticket #48; executed the v1 freeze (branch+tag at 07376d0b, release PR closed); built a 9-commit handover PR (#616) retiring v1 release automation, single-sourcing toolchains, removing GSD artifacts, adopting the blueprint corpus, restoring ship-phase as /ship, switching to AGENTS.md as source of truth, removing PR attribution footers, and rewriting README.md for v2 with a landing-page npm→pnpm conversion.

repo: cipher-box uses SHA-pinned GitHub Actions (zizmor-enforced) with a workflow_call chain: ci-e2e.yml calls web-e2e.yml/desktop-e2e.yml; tag-staging.yml calls those plus deploy-staging.yml

release-please historically used 16 independent components with a pr-release-preview.yml bot that pushes a load-bearing chore(release) commit onto PR branches — force-pushing over it silently drops version bumps

Rust toolchain was pinned via apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml but every CI job overrode it with `rustup default stable`, so the pin was dead — fixed by root rust-toolchain.toml + removing the override steps
tee-worker Dockerfile used node:20-alpine while api/mock-ipns used node:22-alpine — inconsistent pinning now resolved via node-version-file/engines single-sourcing
staging deploy is SSH/SCP (appleboy actions) + docker compose on a single VPS pulling from GHCR — not a managed platform
cipher-box-next's CLAUDE.md→AGENTS.md pointer pattern (yankey-beats is the actual mirrored example) lets CLAUDE.md be just `@AGENTS.md` so other harnesses can consume the same source of truth

landing/ page used npm with its own package-lock.json, separate from the pnpm workspace root — required a distinct conversion (pnpm import --ignore-workspace) rather than folding into root pnpm-lock.yaml
deploy-landing.yml also built via npm and cached on the now-removed npm lockfile — easy to miss since it's not part of the root workspace, found only via a repo-wide reference re-check
workflow: zsh aborts an entire compound command on an unmatched glob (e.g. `rm ... gsd-*.json` with no matches) — split risky glob deletions into separate commands

1Password SSH commit signing intermittently hangs/fails ('failed to fill whole buffer'); standing rule is to timeout-guard signed commit attempts and verify landing via `git log` before retrying, never silently fall back to --no-gpg-sign without explicit user authorization
`gh pr edit` fails under GitHub's Projects-classic deprecation; use `gh api -X PATCH .../issues/<n> -F body=@file` instead
always prefix gh calls with `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN` in this environment
ruby's plain `YAML.load(File.read(f))` was a reliable fallback for validating GitHub Actions workflow YAML when python's yaml module was unavailable and ruby's safe loader rejected anchors/aliases
when adapting rather than deleting a workflow-specific tool (ship-phase.md), recover original content via `git show HEAD~1:<path>` before rewriting

friction: 1Password SSH commit signing hung/failed multiple times across the session, requiring background retry loops and eventually a one-time user-authorized --no-gpg-sign bypass
gh issue view --comments doesn't work due to Projects-classic GraphQL deprecation, requiring REST API fallback
Write tool repeatedly errored with 'File has not been read yet' on files that existed but hadn't been Read first in this session (release-please.yml, DEPLOYMENT.md, CONTEXT.md)

python-based find/replace on crypto-privacy-review.md failed with ValueError because the .learnings/** block was the last path entry with no trailing anchor — needed exact-block string replacement instead
markdownlint caught broken code-fence nesting and stale .planning/ references in crypto-privacy-review.md that had gone unnoticed until lint-staged ran
open_items: Merge decision on PR #616 belongs to the user

After #616 merges: scaffold the D3 workspace skeleton (crates/{core,engine,fuse,wasm}, packages/client, apps/{web,desktop,api}) and seed a GitHub-issues v2 milestone tracker, one issue per PR-sized slice from blueprint docs, built in dependency order starting with crates/core
Confirm final CI status on PR #616's latest head (README + landing pnpm conversion commits) before merge
1Password will need an unlock/approval before the next signed commit reliably works
